metadata.name: wasmcanvas
metadata.description: (id, engine?, active?) - the body of a wasm window: a focusable <canvas id="wasm-<id>"> the engine grabs by id. Focus/blur toggle wasm.<id>.active; keydown/keyup route to the engine (active-gated).

metadata.name: wasmwin.focus
metadata.description: (state, id) - the wasm canvas gained focus → mark it the active wasm window (keys route here).

metadata.name: wasmwin.blur
metadata.description: (state, id) - lost focus → no longer the active wasm window.

metadata.name: wasmwin.key
metadata.description: (state, id, event) - a keystroke on the canvas → route to the engine inbox if this window is active.
